context: Reference review: Java 8 cannot use Optional.stream, takeWhile, or Stream.toList; the prefix behavior must still be preserved.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a clear decision.

checklist.name: Rejects proposed change
checklist.description: Clearly says the proposed refactor should not be accepted on a Java 8 project.

checklist.name: Catches Optional.stream incompatibility
checklist.description: Explains that Optional.stream() is Java 9+, not Java 8.

checklist.name: Catches takeWhile incompatibility
checklist.description: Explains that Stream.takeWhile() is Java 9+, not Java 8.

checklist.name: Catches Stream.toList incompatibility
checklist.description: Explains that Stream.toList() is Java 16+, not Java 8.

checklist.name: Preserves prefix semantics in alternative
checklist.description: Suggests keeping the break-based loop or another Java 8-compatible implementation that stops at the first invisible event rather than filtering all events.
